changes_by_csc: Existing PT codes that the dump lists were kept; their locality names and points were taken from it and withheld where the dump's rows for one code disagree; regions mapped to CSC state iso2; points formatted to eight decimals; city links rebuilt or cleared; no new codes added.
state_mapping: GeoNames admin1 code to the CSC state iso2 by the provider table https://www.geonames.org/PT/administrative-division-portugal.html
point_scope: Published estimated postcode/place coordinates, as is; never a city, seat or municipality coordinate correction or a certified postcode-area centroid.
